bounds.directed: 2 vertices, 0..2 edges; all nonempty endpoint sets
bounds.higher_order: 2 vertices, 0..2 edges; all nonempty self-excluding endpoint sets
bounds.candidate_stores: 2 vertices, 2 edges; all subsets of 16 roles including self-end roles
bounds.recursive: 2 vertices, 2 edges; all nonempty self-excluding member sets; acyclicity/extensionality filter
bounds.attributed: one atom per class; 2^4 endpoint, 2^2 direction, 2^6 fragment, 2^4 attribute-presence assignments
bounds.metapath: all B,C,F subsets for directed sources; edge-sequence bound 2|F|+1
bounds.compact: 2 vertices, 4 ordered edges; all earlier-endpoint pairs
bounds.temporal: all subsets of 7 fixed components; dependency-closure filter

revision2.necessity: one witness per constraint (18 constraints, 5 families); each rejected, accepted when only that constraint is dropped, still rejected when any other single constraint is dropped
revision2.randomized: seed 20261005; 1500 random models per family (D,HO,BB up to 8 vertices and 8 edges; U up to 6+6; A up to 3 atoms per class), 2 random mutations each
revision2.strata_cascade: 1500 random NF4 stores (about 10-60 rows): rank partition, minimality chain, cascade rounds and fixpoint
revision2.firing: exhaustive: 3 vertices, 0..2 edges, nonempty ends, all B,C,F; randomized: 4000 structures with 2..6 vertices and 1..4 edges with sequence oracle
revision2.temporal: 1500 random histories per policy over horizon 4, every (t,v) point; dependency and clock premises asserted

limits: Bounded and sampled checks; Lean covers only the directed/higher-order/BB roundtrip under canonical naming; no engine benchmarks; temporal histories are sampled, not exhaustive.
